previousIssues.issue: w9b HIGH: door viewing window hidden behind the mirrored monuments handle housing at all doors
previousIssues.status: fixed. b_doorWin, s06, s07 and ra_door2floor all show the window again, forward of the housing (wz = c - 0.30), with the arc's arrowhead pointing at it. That matches the newly downloaded lalf_133 (door 2L): the window is beside the grip at grip height, about 0.24 x 0.50 m including the reveal. Ours is 0.20 x 0.46, which is close. The reveal's aft rim now sits flush against the housing with no clipping (3x crop ra10c/z_b_doorWin_w10.png). Helps a lot.

previousIssues.issue: w9a M / w9b L: galley/door vinyl a uniform slab with no cloud mottle
previousIssues.status: fixed. ra_door2floor (380-560 x 330-550) now measures an L std of 14.6 (w9 6.3) and a low-frequency std (12 px blur) of 13.0 (w9 4.9), against sans_09 at 24.1 and 12.5. Helps.

previousIssues.issue: w9a L / w9b L: door surround has no stop fittings (fr_20220604_123806)
previousIssues.status: 'fixed' but MOOT, and my w9 request was wrong. Six 16 x 60 x 30 mm boxes per jamb were added in MAT.door, 8 mm proud of the door face at c +/- 0.555. They cannot be seen in any render (b_doorWin, s06, s07 at 3x). lalf_133, a cabin-side photo of door 2L, shows no stop fittings: fr_123806 sees them only because the door is open from the jet bridge, and with the door closed the lining covers them. They are harmless; removing them saves 12 boxes per door.

details.detail: Sidewall panels and seams. Satin white with a joint every second window, clean in s01, s02, s05 and s09. Still plain satin where tt_window shows a fine linen weave.
F/J bowl geometry: width, short bowl, LED pill under the opening and smooth sides all match ml_DSC_1920 and tt_window.
PY/Y full-height tub and raised bezel. The hood profile now matches sp_py14 (shadow under the lip, peak, then a ramp down to the bezel), and the tubs read concave at aisle distance in s02.
Recess tonal modelling and colour. The grade is right, but the bowls are dead neutral (s 0.005-0.014) against cream in the photos (lighting).
Pane tunnel lining and seal rim. Unchanged and good.

Electric shades. The LED is now right. The blackout went darker in the cabin: (102,100,94) against a wall of (225,226,228), 0.45, where w9 was 0.64 and omaat_room24 is 0.65. The albedo is unchanged, so this comes from lighting. There is mild moire at mid distance.
Manual PY/Y shades (stowed band, half, closed). Unchanged.
Dado panel, air-return grilles, placards. Unchanged.
Carpets and Y seat-track covers. Unchanged.
Door cross-aisle / galley vinyl. The clouds now match sans_09 at low frequency, and the tone is right with a faintly cool cast.

Type A door surround and viewing window. The window is back, forward of the grip, and its size and position are close to lalf_133. The glass is blown out to white, as it is in the photo. Ours lacks the photo's slightly deeper, darker-rimmed reveal and its lighter cream jamb trim strips with small vertical assist grips. The stop fittings are invisible and unnecessary.

issues.detail: [LIGHTING, affects shell] Closed blackout dropped to 0.45 of the wall (w9 0.64, photo 0.65)
issues.problem: b_jClose shade (520-620 x 330-460) is (102,100,94) against a wall of (225,226,228). In w9 it was (136,134,126) against (214,215,215). 07_shell's blackout albedo is unchanged since w8, so the lighting snapshots 282136c / 9f2d20e (04_shaders, 12_scene) darkened the shade while brightening the wall. The pleated shades now read as dark grey slabs in b_jClose and s05; omaat_room24 shows a mid taupe-grey.
issues.fix: Lighting: check what the new shader does to the shade instances (window sun LUT / AO volume occluding the shade plane?). Per 56bb5c7, do not retune materials during the lighting loop. If lighting settles here, the shell fallback is blackout #aaa498 -> about #c8c1b3 to get back to ~0.63.

issues.fix: Lighting (white mood colour temperature). Do not change the shell albedo for now.
